title: Born again through the Spirit — John 3
paragraphs: Born again through the Spirit — John 3

And Jesus still told him, “You must be born again.”
Not improved.
Not polished.
Born again.
That is the shock of John 3.

Nicodemus came to Jesus with status, knowledge, and questions. But Jesus went straight to the wound beneath the religion: flesh cannot produce spirit. Human effort cannot create divine life. Church attendance cannot resurrect a dead heart. Good behavior cannot make a sinner new.

Jesus was not shaming Nicodemus. He was exposing the mercy of God. The new birth is not something you achieve. It is something the Spirit performs. You cannot manufacture salvation. You must receive it. “That which is born of the flesh is flesh, and that which is born of the Spirit is spirit” (John 3:6).

We were not just misguided. We were dead in sin. And dead people do not need inspiration. They need resurrection. That is why Jesus came. He would go from that midnight conversation to a bloody cross, bearing the judgment we deserved, so that all who believe in Him would not perish but have eternal life (John 3:16). The Spirit gives new birth because the Son gave His life.

You do not need a better mask.
You need a new heart.
You do not need spiritual cosmetics.
You need spiritual life.
And in Christ, that miracle is real.

No past is too filthy.
No heart is too cold.
No sinner is too far gone.
The same Spirit who causes the wind to move where it wills can breathe life into you today. Repent. Believe in Jesus. Be made new.
